characters.role: Unnamed first-person sorcerer whose immortality investigation becomes limited blood-pattern research

selectionEvidence.quote: I had spent nine years approaching this morning

Then I lifted each vessel from the frame

characters.form: Living adult human sorcerer; gender unspecified

storyAppearance.anatomy: Human, thin, shaking hand and twitching thumb during overwork.
storyAppearance.lifeStage: Adult with9years study; exact age unstated.
storyAppearance.equipment: Research book/ledger, sealed separately marked sample vessels, carrying case, pulse-board; light comes from own hand only while working.
storyAppearance.movement: Palm on pulse plate, fatigued thumb, finally carries case level against chest down path.
storyAppearance.distinctiveFeatures: Finite living researcher, no successful immortality; no self-moving blood.

explicitCanon: Local non-canon story fact: Narrator sorcerer spent9years pursuing immortality; healer says thin.

characters.name: Fenessa

selectionEvidence.quote: you read the permissions back to me
The healer had relabeled an authorized subset
testing each buried edge with her staff
with a lantern and a sack of barley

storyAppearance.materials: Wool coat, wet/snowy boots, ordinary human skin.
storyAppearance.clothing: Wool coat with dark wet shoulders, boots.
storyAppearance.equipment: Permission ledger, sample case, lantern, barley sack, staff for path testing.
storyAppearance.movement: Keeps hands on case until permissions read, crosses out false classifications, purposeful walking and staff probing.
storyAppearance.distinctiveFeatures: Authority through care and rigorous boundaries; no healing light stated.

explicitCanon: Local non-canon story fact: Woman healer; wool coat, boots, ledger, lantern/barley/staff supported.

No invented healer insignia, weapon, glowing hands.

characters.name: Rovel
characters.role: Unnamed mill resident harmed by prior charm who withdraws sample and demands accountability

selectionEvidence.quote: He was thinner. The gray under his eyes
Keep the note about what happened.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Defines final limits on retained information.

storyAppearance.anatomy: Thinner than before trial, gray under eyes, unsteady after linked pattern harm; ordinary human.
storyAppearance.proportions: Thin, weakened; no permanent deformity stated.
storyAppearance.clothing: Boots wrapped in blankets during rest; other clothes unspecified.
storyAppearance.equipment: Cup, blanket; cheese briefly pocketed; no healing equipment or magic tool.
storyAppearance.movement: Two fingers beneath ribs, steadies himself on furniture, later clears lower path.
storyAppearance.distinctiveFeatures: His boundaries and physical harm remain real; no blood transfers into him.

explicitCanon: Local non-canon story fact: Male mill resident, thinner and gray-eyed after prior charm; dizzy and rib discomfort.

Faded green workshirt, oatmeal wool waistcoat, dark trousers, worn boots; explicit blanket around boots in small rest detail.
No visible wounds, transfusion tubes or magical blood marks.
